name: sustainable-supplier-cockpit
description: Prototype by Team Scromen. All data is fictitious.

scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.dev:server: npm run build -w shared && npm run start:dev -w server
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w shared && npm run dev -w web
scripts.lint: npm run build -w shared && npm run lint --workspaces
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.test: npm run build -w shared && npm run test --workspaces
scripts.data:build: npm run build -w shared && npm run generate -w @scc/data
